title: Security pack
lead: Answers procurement and IT typically ask before a PTTCRM demo. Nothing here claims a certificate that has not been issued.

sections.title: Encryption and access
sections.body: Transport uses TLS 1.2+. Staff access to demo inbox and CMS is least-privilege and audited. The marketing site does not embed the operations console.

sections.title: Data residency
sections.body: Production CRM and portal data is hosted in Singapore (AWS ap-southeast-1) unless a contract says otherwise. Marketing-site demo leads are stored in the same region.

sections.title: DPA and SCCs
sections.body: EU/UK prospects use the Data Processing Agreement on this site. Standard Contractual Clauses apply where a sub-processor transfers data outside the EEA, as stated on each vendor DPA (AWS, Stripe).

sections.title: Sub-processors
sections.body: The public list is limited to vendors actually in use. Names prefixed for internal drafting are never shown.

sections.title: SOC 2
sections.body: SOC 2 Type I is in progress. The Trust Center links a report only after PO and auditor sign-off. We do not display a badge before that.

sections.title: SSO and MFA
sections.body: Enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) and MFA are on the product roadmap for IT checklists of 80+ staff. They are not claimed as generally available on this site.

sections.title: Availability
sections.body: Target is 99.9% monthly uptime for the marketing site, demo API, and public CMS read path. The status page publishes incidents and a 90-day history only after production monitoring has enough measured days.

seo.title: Security pack | PTTCRM Trust
seo.description: Encryption, residency, DPA/SCCs, SOC 2 status, and SSO roadmap for PTTCRM procurement.
